name: Jugan, the Rising Star
description: The great ryuu of Kamigawa's forests and guardian of Jukai Forest, later reincarnated as Kura.

description_citations.text: "Jugan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War, Jugan is summoned by the Fudaiju Monks and later the orochi; he dies and passes his strength to the monks.
timeline.quote: Eventually he died and passed his strength on to the monks.

citation.text: "Jugan", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A wave of oni attacks culminates in the Night of Withering; the orochi resurrect Jugan, who with Ryusei defeats the oni.
timeline.quote: together Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion

citation.text: "Jugan", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jugan collects the essences of the other dragons, places them in an egg with Ryusei, and the egg is sealed in Boseiju.
timeline.quote: The egg was sealed into the heart of Boseiju

citation.text: "Jugan", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After fifty years, Jugan is reborn as Kura, the Boundless Sky.
timeline.quote: His new form was that of Kura

relations.quote: Kura is the reincarnation of Jugan
